name: Zhengzhou Xinzheng International Airport
before:
Henan's main airport and the gateway to the central plain, in Xinzheng 37 km south east of downtown Zhengzhou. It handled 29,191,990 passengers in 2025, seventeenth in mainland China, and is sixth in the country for cargo. Cargolux runs a hub here.

Terminal 2 is the one to head for. It is the only terminal currently in operation, opened in December 2015 and laid out in an X shape with four piers, meant to read as open arms. The north west pier handles international flights and the others are domestic. Terminal 1 has been closed and used as an exhibition hall.

The ground transport centre next to Terminal 2 is genuinely useful. It has an intercity train station and a metro station on its underground floors alongside taxis and intercity coaches, all connected to the arrivals hall by three corridors, so onward travel across the region does not need a road transfer.

The code CGO comes from Chengchow, the old romanisation of Zhengzhou.
after:
Henan's main airport, 37 km south east of downtown Zhengzhou. It handled 29.2 million passengers in 2025, seventeenth in mainland China. For cargo it ranked sixth in the country.

Xinzheng Airport station is on the metro's Chengjiao line, which runs into Zhengzhou.

sources.quote: The airport is the largest international airport in Henan and serves as a main gateway for the province and the central plain area.

claims.note: Replaces the ground transport centre paragraph. The metro's own page lists the station on the Chengjiao line, which begins at Nansihuan (South Fourth Ring Road) station in Zhengzhou, and times trains through from Jiahe and Liuzhuang (the Line 2 termini). The intercity train rests on Wikipedia alone.

claims.claim: gateway to the central plain; in Xinzheng; exact passenger figure; Cargolux hub
claims.wasBefore: Henan's main airport and the gateway to the central plain, in Xinzheng 37 km south east of downtown Zhengzhou. It handled 29,191,990 passengers in 2025, seventeenth in mainland China, and is sixth in the country for cargo. Cargolux runs a hub here.
claims.why: Kept, rounded and tightened. 'Gateway to the central plain' and 'in Xinzheng' are Wikipedia alone. Cargolux's own about and network pages do not mention Zhengzhou; a 2016 NetEase report confirms Cargolux's Zhengzhou to Luxembourg flights and its 2014 tie-up with Henan, but not a hub, and it is ten years old.

claims.claim: Terminal 2 only terminal in use; opened December 2015; X shape, four piers; north west pier international; Terminal 1 closed, exhibition hall
claims.wasBefore: Terminal 2 is the one to head for. It is the only terminal currently in operation, opened in December 2015 and laid out in an X shape with four piers, meant to read as open arms. The north west pier handles international flights and the others are domestic. Terminal 1 has been closed and used as an exhibition hall.
claims.why: No current second source for the terminal layout, and there is a reason to doubt it: the metro's own line page (23 Sep 2026) lists a 'Terminal 3' station (3号航站楼站) on the Chengjiao line, next to Xinzheng Airport station. Whether a third terminal is open could not be checked (the operator's sites answered 503). The pier layout and the exhibition hall are Wikipedia alone; an airport advertising site (zhengzhou-airport.com) says Terminal 1 closed on 30 March 2016 when all flights moved to Terminal 2, but it is undated.
